title: Roll Dispenser
description: A wall-mounted kitchen roll dispenser. The project ran from sketch ideation through paper and cardboard prototypes, testing how a single folded form could hold the roll and present the next sheet, to a final rendered visualization in a kitchen.

brief.text: A wall-mounted holder for a kitchen roll.

brief.label: Process
brief.text: Sketch ideation, then quick paper and cardboard prototypes to test the fold, then a final rendered visualization.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Commercial dispensers from Kimberly-Clark, Bobrick and Franke, and simple residential holders from housewares brands.
